origin.ref: public string BuyerId { get; private set; }
public int Quantity { get; private set; }
public decimal UnitPrice { get; private set; }

invocations.name: SELECT Baskets JOIN BasketItems WHERE BuyerId = @user

assumptions.text: The supplied unit price is read from the catalog item returned by GetByIdAsync

decisions.text: The basket page omits the quantity argument, so AddItemToBasket uses its default quantity of one
A new basket line records the catalog price read when the item is added

language_gaps.text: The nullable product identifier check is unreachable for the view-model integer identifier
A missing catalog item redirects to the home page without a message; it is modeled as a rejection with no effect

properties.text: a missing item creates neither a basket nor a basket line
a new basket line stores one unit at the catalog price
adding an item that is already present adds one unit without changing its price
a successful add leaves a basket for the resolved shopper
an authenticated shopper is identified by their user name and receives no basket cookie
an anonymous shopper with a valid GUID cookie reuses that basket
an anonymous shopper without a valid GUID cookie receives a new basket identity and cookie
a missing request identity cannot resolve a basket buyer
basket line quantities are never negative
adding an existing item increases that line's quantity
adding units to an existing line does not change its unit price
a new line stores its basket, item, quantity, and unit price
an out-of-range quantity does not create or change a line
